efficiency.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

stats.note: exploratory analysis; Holm-adjusted across the pairwise comparisons reported in the manuscript

background_bias.reference: Noyan 2022 (arXiv:2206.04374) reports 49.0% from 8 background pixels vs 2.6% chance

grape leaf spot.reason: 'grape leaf spot' is used for several grape foliar diseases; PlantWild also carries 'grape downy mildew' separately, so the intended pathogen is not determinable from the label alone

apple mosaic virus.reason: no apple mosaic class exists in PlantVillage

cherry leaf spot.reason: PlantVillage has no cherry leaf-spot class

finetune_plantdoc.split_note: official PlantDoc train partition split into fit/val; official test partition held out

finetune_plantwild.split_note: PlantWild ships no partition file; seeded stratified 70/10/20 split created here

gradcam_field.sampling: 8/class over all classes + up to 60 misclassified images (of 2127 available)

faithfulness.note: lower deletion AUC and higher insertion AUC indicate a more faithful map

gradcam_indomain.sampling: 10/class over all classes + up to 40 misclassified images (of 7 available)

faithfulness.note: lower deletion AUC and higher insertion AUC indicate a more faithful map
